The EAMC consists mainly of Paleozoic polydeformed turbidite successions and located under and around the present South Patagonian Icefield (SPI) ( 72 ).
The CMC consists predominantly of Mesozoic metaturbidites and crops out throughout the Chonos Archipelago and the Taitao Peninsula ( 73 ).

The model experiment is performed with the objective of simulating a “Heinrich stadial” assuming that it is triggered by the subsurface ocean warming in the North Atlantic due to the start of the cold phase after a Dansgaard–Oeschger (DO) event ( 84 , 85 ).
A fully coupled atmosphere-ocean general circulation model (AOGCM), MIROC4m, developed in Japan ( 86 ), was used for this study.
